messages:
Maya (Finance): Heads up: ACME Health invoice 8247 renewal failed, card declined. Customer emailed.
Sam (Payments): Share decline payload?
Maya (Finance): gateway -> status=declined; code=92; reason=issuer_referred; cvv=match; avs=partial
Eli (Support): Customer updated card last week and tried UI retry, same decline.
Sam (Payments): 92 = call issuer. Also 3DS not completed in flow. Gateway shows acquirer_referred and fallback acquirers same.
payments-bot: webhook event payment_failed for intent.8247 decline_code=92
Nora (Accounting): Options: short grace, manual collect, wire, or temporary credit. Invoice is $18,200.
Eli (Support): Customer wants wire if we can't charge. Wants instructions ASAP.
Maya (Finance): Prefer wire + pause auto-retries. Any KYC limits?
Nora (Accounting): Wires cleared <= $50k. I can send instructions.
Sam (Payments): Also tell customer to re-add card via desktop to complete 3DS; try one immediate attempt only.
Eli (Support): I'll message: "Option A: re-add card on desktop to finish 3DS; Option B: reply 'WIRE' for instructions. We'll pause retries for 48h."
payments-bot: followup reminder set for 48h on invoice 8247
Maya (Finance): If they choose wire, Nora add beneficiary contact and ask for bank confirmation. I'll disable auto-retry.
Nora (Accounting): Draft wire: Bank: First Union Bank; Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.; Acct: 987654321; ABA: 123456789; SWIFT: FUBKUS33; Ref: invoice 8247
Sam (Payments): Good. Ask them to include invoice ref in payment details so we can match.
Eli (Support): Customer replied: "WIRE". Sending to finance. :thumbsup: 
Nora (Accounting): Sent email with wire instrs and requested proof of transfer. Subject: "Redwood Inference - Wire instructions for invoice 8247"
Sam (Payments): Once we get proof we'll mark paid and stop gateway retries. Add internal note to prevent auto-refund.
Maya (Finance): Action: create KB about desktop 3DS and a triage step for decline_code=92. Closing loop after payment clears.
Eli (Support): Noted, will follow up when treasury confirms. :white_check_mark:
